name: ml-income-tax
description: Mali wage income tax research draft for 2026, reconstructing the older DGI Impôt sur les Traitements et Salaires provisions without claiming an operative 2026 amendment chain. Use it for conditional annual ITS workpapers covering employment income, residence and source, pension deductions, annual progressive bands, family reductions and reconciliation of amounts withheld, with final ITS held where the neighbouring relief formula is unresolved. It corrects the former Guide's unsupported flat non-resident rate and distinguishes a housing-lease residence condition from a universal day-count test. The DGI's August 2025 bulletin clarifies a disputed 2024 table but does not prove later continuity. This draft includes two executable annual cases. Other personal income categories, current payroll conversion rules, forms and treaty procedures remain outside verified coverage.
